cellpose.recipe: tools.detector_screen.cellpose_adapter; eager BF16 batch 8, native 3D, metadata anisotropy, unchanged benchmark defaults

evaluation: All nodes and edges of each complete 100-frame clip, integer native centroids, official GEFF total-node estimate, fresh official matching and micro aggregation.
exposure: Frozen external pretrained checkpoint, no fitting or label-based tuning; reused public embryos and unresolved inherited checkpoint exposure. Exploratory local evaluation. Event-cost controls are development ablations on the already inspected pilot panel.
geometry: Audit SQL z/y/x against the serialized mask centroid and recomputed rounded native-mask centroid before linking. Pinned ultrack rounds centroids before insertion, so no coordinate changes are required. CSV uses np.rint.
selection: Declared before this bounded cost study was scored; previous six-clip stock results and error audit were already inspected. A 0.01 extra cost for a fork relative to a new track; an interior second link must supply IoU^4 > 0.01 (IoU > 0.3162) in the fixed-node local comparison. This is an objective-scale control, not a fitted biological prior. No further search or best-run replacement is part of this study.
